_comment: Provenance registry. A rule block marked '! @source: <id>' may only use ids listed here, and validate.py rejects ids whose license cannot be reused under our license (build.json 'license'). 'watch' entries are monitored weekly by .github/workflows/upstream-watch.yml (report only, never auto-applied). Licenses checked via the GitHub API on 2026-11-06.
